mentions.name: FreeBSD on EC2
mentions.description: An ongoing effort to make FreeBSD work better on Amazon EC2, currently centered on tracking down an issue with the ENA network interface that causes sporadic packet loss when a large number of TCP segments are pushed to the NIC very fast. Investigation so far suggests a connection with write combining on the MMIO space used for low-latency queueing, possibly a firmware bug in the ENA device.
mentions.problem: The ENA network interface on EC2 exhibits sporadic packet loss that is hard to reproduce, apparently requiring large numbers of TCP segments pushed to the NIC very quickly.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The same thing I do every night - try to make FreeBSD work better on EC2!

Ok in all seriousness, right now I'm tracking down an issue with the ENA network interface which results in sporadic packet loss.
